import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sales by Product
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(product_sales))
ax1.bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales by Time of Day
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
df['hour'] = df['datetime'].dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax2.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#2ecc71')
ax2.set_title('Sales by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Customer Age Group Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
age_group_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(age_group_sales))
ax3.pie(age_group_sales.values, labels=age_group_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Payment Method Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
ax4.bar(payment_counts.index, payment_counts.values, color=['#3498db', '#e74c3c'])
ax4.set_title('Payment Method Usage', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Payment Method')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count')

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
takeaway_sales = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors_takeaway = ['#9b59b6', '#f39c12']
ax5.bar(labels, [takeaway_sales.get(0, 0), takeaway_sales.get(1, 0)], color=colors_takeaway)
ax5.set_title('Sales: Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')

# 6. Product Size Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
size_counts = df['size'].value_counts()
ax6.barh(size_counts.index, size_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(size_counts)))
ax6.set_title('Product Size Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Count')
ax6.set_ylabel('Size')

# 7. Quantity Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.hist(df['quantity'], bins=10, color='#1abc9c', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_title('Quantity Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Quantity')
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 8. Average Price by Product and Size
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='price', index='product', columns='size', aggfunc='mean')
sns.heatmap(pivot_data, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=ax8, cbar_kws={'label': 'Avg Price ($)'})
ax8.set_title('Average Price by Product & Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Total Sales Over Time
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
daily_sales = df.groupby('date')['total'].sum()
ax9.bar(range(len(daily_sales)), daily_sales.values, color='#e67e22')
ax9.set_title('Daily Total Sales', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Day')
ax9.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')

# Add main title
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
